---
title: "Create issue"
description: "Opens an issue for the PR author when a check fails."
---

`create-issue.yml` opens an issue titled *Pull Request test showed possible
problems* with the labels `bug` and `review`, links the failed run and
assigns the PR author (plus any extra assignees). In the
[release chain](release.qmd) it runs when R CMD check fails on the
`dev` → `main` PR.

## Example

It is used as a job inside the release trigger:

```yaml
  on-failure:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.result == 'failure'
    uses: FlorianSchw/package-workflows/.github/workflows/create-issue.yml@main
    with:
      pr_author: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
      run_url: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
```
